general.sub: Kit summary · pick your Hero talent above

i: While channeling Dark Harvest (1 min), Shadow of Death grants a Soul Shard containing a Succulent Soul every 1 sec. Spend the shards right away on Seed of Corruption or Unstable Affliction (Wowhead)
Spending a Succulent Soul releases a Demonic Soul for extra damage, and Manifested Avarice also hits nearby enemies for 9 sec
Curse of Tongues and Banish are only in the Soul Harvester build. Shadowfury drops to a 45 sec cooldown via Oppressive Darkness
Wowhead rates Soul Harvester as the stronger hero talent for both single-target and M+
Apply Wither instead of Corruption. Each Unstable Affliction raises Wither stacks via Blackened Soul, and extra damage fires as the stacks collapse
Malevolence (1 min) deals extra damage to enemies with Wither for 20 sec and adds 6 stacks. Overlap it with Dark Harvest on the same big pull
Curse of Weakness becomes Curse of the Satyr, which also adds a 30% cast time increase. Use it instead of Curse of Tongues
Dark Pact gains Zevrim's Resilience, healing you every 1 sec while it's active
Summon Darkglare · 2 min · for 20 sec (+5 sec via Eye Contract), Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal 20% more damage. While active, Shadow Bolt becomes Malefic Grasp
Dark Harvest · 1 min · 3 sec channel that damages every enemy with your DoTs and heals you for 50% of the damage dealt
Haunt · 15 sec · target takes 16% more damage from you for 18 sec. Cooldown resets if the target dies
Unending Resolve · 3 min · 25% less damage taken for 8 sec, immune to interrupts and silences
Dark Pact · 1 min · sacrifice 20% of current health for a 20 sec shield worth 200% of it (+ spell power scaling). Usable while CC'd. Soul Harvester absorbs 50% more via Friends In Dark Places
Healthstone · 1 min · instantly heals 25% health, with extra healing from Empowered Healthstone (both builds)
Mortal Coil · 45 sec · incapacitates one enemy for 3 sec and heals you for 20% max health (bosses immune)
Spell Lock · 24 sec · interrupt used via Command Demon with the Felhunter out; locks the school for 7 sec. With the Imp out you have no interrupt
Shadowfury · 1 min (45 sec for Soul Harvester) · after a 1.5 sec cast, stuns enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec (bosses immune). Goes into the AoE stop rotation (Wowhead)
Blight of Tongues · 2 min · increases cast time of enemies within 10 yards of the target by 100% for 12 sec. Via Foul Mouth, Curse of Tongues and Curse of Exhaustion also apply in a 10-yard AoE
Singe Magic · 15 sec · Imp only, removes 1 harmful magic effect from an ally. You have to swap to the Imp and lose Spell Lock meanwhile. Swap pets instantly with Fel Domination (3 min)
Devour Magic · 15 sec · the Felhunter removes 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy
Pre-place Demonic Circle; returning with Demonic Circle: Teleport (30 sec) clears movement slows. Using Soulburn first adds 50% movement speed and snare/root immunity for 6 sec
Demonic Gateway · a gate linking two points, usable once per 90 sec per person. Burning Rush gives 50% movement speed but costs 4% max health every 1 sec
Put Soulstone (10 min) on the healer; it also works as an in-combat res. Hand out Healthstones to the party with Create Soulwell (Wowhead)
Ascendant week: control orbs all at once with Shadowfury; if they're scattered, use Mortal Coil (Wowhead)
Voidbound week: Dark Harvest has a short cooldown, so don't hold back major cooldowns on the big enemy (Wowhead)
Pulsar week: move fast with Burning Rush to collide with other party members' orbs, then turn it off to ease the healer's load (Wowhead)
Devour week: it's cleared by slow removal, so clear it with Soulburn then Demonic Circle: Teleport (Wowhead)
Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: each death costs 15 sec

soul-harvester.title: Soul Harvester notes
items: Line up {Dark Harvest} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows, and spend the Soul Shards gained during the channel on {Seed of Corruption} right away (Wowhead)
While {Summon Darkglare} is active, pump DoT damage with {Malefic Grasp}

hellcaller.title: Hellcaller notes
items: Overlap {Malevolence} and {Dark Harvest} on the same big pull
Build {Wither} stacks with {Unstable Affliction} to increase {Blackened Soul} damage

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield (Topicx). Use Dark Harvest (1 min) and Haunt on every shield, and Summon Darkglare (2 min) on a shield whenever it is back
[참고] The group lines up its defensives with Ravenous Stomp's AoE damage (Topicx), so press Dark Pact (1 min) right before Stomp
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put the Felhunter's Spell Lock into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts. With a 24 sec cooldown it covers only one. Set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)
[위치] Taking a Demonic Gateway during Death Rattle breaks the Vine Grip tether quickly (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] If Bloodlust was saved for the second boss it goes on the Uncoil split (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with it and spread Seed of Corruption across the five Writhes. Stun any Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target with Shadowfury
Zul'jan: [참고] It's a single-target boss, so keep Haunt, Agony, and Unstable Affliction rolling and use Summon Darkglare on cooldown
[광역 피해] Pop Dark Pact while blocking a Ritual of the Fang beam, and add Unending Resolve if Ritual Venom has stacked high

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] The three bosses share damage, so put Agony on all three and add AoE damage with Seed of Corruption
[차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Holy) does not need a kick rotation. Kick it with Spell Lock (24 sec) when it is available (Topicx)

[위치] Standing inside Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking Loam's Nature damage (77586 every 1 sec) and the beam's Holy damage (77586 every 2 sec) together, so press Dark Pact before stepping in. When the beam ends, clear Loam's 50% slow with Soulburn and Demonic Circle: Teleport to get out
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [위치] Soulburn followed by Demonic Circle: Teleport gives 6 sec of root and snare immunity, letting you avoid Bloodthorn Roots and get away from a Bloodthirsty Gaze chase (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Cycle Dark Pact on cooldown during the post-50% Lightcrazed Frenzy phase
[참고] Bloodlust goes below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with it
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Spell Lock into the kick rotation for Moonkin Form's Warden's Wrath

[위치] If you are marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still, aim the cone (164870 Physical every 2 sec for 6 sec) away from the group and press Dark Pact (Topicx). If Grievous Thrash is still bleeding you, top yourself off with a Healthstone before the cone to clear the bleed
[참고] Save Unending Resolve for the Spirits of the Vale phase after 40%
Ziekket: [위치] Pop Dark Pact or Unending Resolve when stepping on Lightbloom's Essence orbs. Your damage goes up, but so does the damage you take (Wowhead)
[차단] Before the revive, Spell Lock the Lashers' Lightspore Shot; if they're grouped, stop them together with Shadowfury

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Pop Dark Pact before Ravenous Bellow
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, Burning Rush over to step on them quickly
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Spell Lock (24 sec) into the kick rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud. Ranged players take the add away from the boss (Topicx), so cover that add's casts
[우선 처치] Both adds must die at the same time (Topicx), so keep Agony and Corruption on both, and put Haunt and Unstable Affliction on your add but move them to the other add if yours gets ahead
[위치] If Raging Squall boxes you in, Demonic Circle: Teleport to a Demonic Circle placed in advance to get out
Nalorakk: [위치] When targeted by Echoing Maul, place Demonic Circle at the group's spot, drop the Echo in a different corner each set, then Demonic Circle: Teleport straight back (Wowhead·Topicx)

[광역 피해] The Echo's landing deals heavy Nature damage around the target, so press Dark Pact when targeted by Echoing Maul (Topicx). If Dark Pact is down when body-blocking Echoes during Fury of the War God, press Unending Resolve
[참고] If the third Bloodlust was not used on pull 14 or Loa Speaker Nanea, it goes here (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare with it

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest into the 20 sec Destabilized window
[차단] Spell Lock one Mirror Images clone's Felstorm, and use Shadowfury on grouped clones
[해제] With the Imp out, Singe Magic can clear 1 Corroding Spittle magic DoT. You lose Spell Lock meanwhile (Wowhead)
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The worker pack is dragged into the fight after the RP and the second Bloodlust goes here (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with it and put Seed of Corruption into the Warehouse Workers. Put Curse of Exhaustion on low workers that run away and let Foul Mouth slow everything within 10 yards
[광역 피해] Use Unending Resolve for Killing Spree, and survive the Murder in a Row bleed with Mortal Coil's heal and a Healthstone
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] The boss takes 30% more damage during Demonic Rage, so line up Summon Darkglare and Haunt there. The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx), so time Darkglare to be ready then too
[회피] Spread before Infernal Crush, and press Unending Resolve if the axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [위치] You can cross Malefic Wave with Demonic Circle: Teleport to a Demonic Circle placed on the far side in advance. Avoid the trail the wave leaves behind (Wowhead)
[차단] Put Spell Lock into the Chaos Bolt kick rotation, and stop Wild Imp packs with Shadowfury before killing them with Seed of Corruption
[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with the adds

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Pop Dark Pact before Dark Bloom
[위치] When grouping near the wall before Umbral Rupture, get into position fast with Burning Rush
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, Haunt it and kill it fast with Unstable Affliction. Haunt's cooldown resets when the Creeper dies
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact before Monstrous Roar

[참고] Bloodlust goes on the first Toxic Creeper (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest on that Creeper. If your damage cooldowns are already up at the pull, match them to a Bloodlust right after the pull
Charonus: [위치] With a pre-placed Demonic Circle, you can escape a Gravitic Orbs fixate or the boss's targeted abilities with Demonic Circle: Teleport (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Use Shadowfury on the Animated Gold packs from Lucre's Call, and apply Curse of Exhaustion (spread via Foul Mouth) to delay them reaching the boss
[광역 피해] Spread Seed of Corruption across Animated Gold packs
Mchimba the Embalmer: [참고] If you are targeted by Drain Fluids, press Dark Pact or Unending Resolve (Wowhead)
[차단] Put Spell Lock into the Half-Finished Mummy Wretched Discharge kick rotation
[위치] A Demonic Gateway placed in the middle of the room lets you move between the Entomb crypts quickly (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on Mchimba (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest at the start, and stack Malevolence on the Hellcaller build
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Kula must die before the fourth Whirling Axes (Topicx), so Haunt Kula and line up Summon Darkglare on it. Put Seed of Corruption into the Royal Berserker and Honored Raptors dragged in
[차단] Kick Zanazal's Poison Nova with Spell Lock
[위치] If you are far away when the group stacks for Aka'ali's Barrel Through, get in quickly with Burning Rush
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar (Topicx), so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest and Haunt Reban to kill it before 80%
[차단] Kick Reban's Deathly Roar with Spell Lock
[광역 피해] Line up Dark Pact and a Healthstone with Gilded Destruction

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx), so keep Spell Lock as a backup for any Frigid Shard the tank misses
[광역 피해] Spread Seed of Corruption across the intermission Infused Whelps, and line up Summon Darkglare with breaking Ice Bulwark
[참고] The intermission is the heaviest group-damage window (Topicx), so press Dark Pact when Frost Overload stacks build up
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Spell Lock into the rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[위치] If you get trapped in a Molten Boulder path, escape with Demonic Circle: Teleport to your pre-placed Demonic Circle
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [위치] With a Demonic Circle placed beforehand, you can dodge frontals such as Roaring Firebreath with Demonic Circle: Teleport (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] If you are an Inferno Spit target, press Dark Pact when the circle explodes at the end of its 6 sec DoT (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest in phase 2, and after the merge Haunt the lower-health boss to finish it first (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] When Storm Blessed moves, Haunt the new target and keep Agony on both bosses
[광역 피해] Pop Dark Pact before soaking Thunder and Lightning
Merektha: [위치] Dodge boss abilities and the Burrow charge with Demonic Circle: Teleport and Demonic Gateway (Wowhead)
[차단] Kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Spell Lock. Spread Seed of Corruption across the Hatch adds after the tank has picked up the Storm Serpent (Topicx)
[광역 피해] The group lines up its defensives with Serpentstorm (Topicx), so press Dark Pact right before Serpentstorm
Galvazzt: [위치] When Galvanized stacks up from taking a Lightning Spire beam, pop Unending Resolve or Dark Pact and swap
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Haunt the Essence Defiler and use Summon Darkglare to kill it fast
[차단] Kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Spell Lock
[제어] In phase 2 the Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, so slow them with Curse of Exhaustion spread by Foul Mouth, stop them with Shadowfury, then kill them with Seed of Corruption (Topicx)
[참고] If soaking Corrupted Lifeforce gives you Corruption or you are the Vile Charge target, press Dark Pact (Method)

1279521.d: Increases the duration of Summon Darkglare by 5.0 sec.

172.d: 대상을 부패시켜 (주문력의 40.3494%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 14초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 266.073%)의 추가 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

686.m: 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
686.d: 적에게 어둠의 화살을 발사하여 (주문력의 174.096%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

688.m: 영혼의 조각 1개 · 6 초 주문 시전 시간
688.d: 원거리에서 적을 불화살로 공격하는 임프를 소환하여 부립니다.

691.m: 영혼의 조각 1개 · 6 초 주문 시전 시간
691.d: 지옥사냥개를 소환하여 부리며 적의 마법 시전을 방해합니다.

702.d:
2분 동안 대상의 공격 간격을 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

저주 주문: 한 대상에게 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

710.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
710.d: 적 악마, 돌연변이 또는 정령을 차원의 저편으로 추방합니다. 추방당한 대상은 30초 동안 어떠한 행동도 할 수 없습니다. 한 번에 하나의 대상으로 제한됩니다. 추방 주문을 대상에게 다시 시전하면 효과가 사라집니다.

980.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
980.d:
대상에게 심화되는 고통을 선사하여 18초에 걸쳐 최대 [(주문력의 9.31297%) * 18 / 2 * 8]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 피해량은 낮게 시작해서 시간이 지날수록 점점 증가합니다. 고통을 갱신하면 현재의 피해량이 그대로 유지됩니다.

고통으로 적에게 피해를 입히면 때때로 영혼의 조각이 1개 생성됩니다.

1714.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
1714.d:
악마어로 말하도록 대상을 강제하여 주문의 시전 시간을 30%만큼 지연시킵니다. 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

저주: 흑마법사마다 한 대상에 동시에 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

5782.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.7 초 주문 시전 시간
5782.d: 적을 공포에 사로잡히게 하여 20초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

6201.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 3 초 주문 시전 시간
6201.d: 생명석을 창조합니다. 생명석을 사용하면 25%의 생명력을 회복합니다.

6262.m: 아이템 효과 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
6262.d: 즉시 25%의 생명력을 회복 [강화된 생명석: 하고, 6초에 걸쳐 추가로 30%만큼 생명력을 회복]합니다.

6789.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
6789.d: 적이 두려움에 휩싸여 달아나게 만들어 3초 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만들고, 자신은 최대 생명력의 20%를 회복합니다.

19505.m: 기력 20 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
19505.d: 적에게서 1개의 이로운 마법 효과를 제거합니다. 마법이 제거되면 지옥사냥개의 생명력이 (주문력의 80%)만큼 회복되고 60의 지옥 마력을 얻습니다.

19647.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 24 초 재사용 대기시간
19647.d: 적의 주문 시전을 차단하여 7초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

20707.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 3 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
20707.d: 대상 파티원 혹은 공격대원의 영혼이 보존되어 대상이 죽었을 때 부활할 수 있습니다. 대상은 60%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지닌 채로 부활합니다.

27243.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 1개 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
27243.d:
적의 몸 안에 악마의 씨앗을 심어 12초 후에 폭발시킵니다. 폭발 시 10미터 내의 모든 적에게 (주문력의 236.5%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 부패 효과를 부여합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

대상이 다른 폭발에 휘말리거나 흑마법사의 주문으로 (암흑 주문력 * 50 / 100)의 피해를 입으면 씨앗이 더 일찍 폭발합니다.

29893.m: 5% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 3 초 주문 시전 시간 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
29893.d: 2분 동안 영혼의 샘을 창조합니다. 파티원과 공격대원이 영혼의 샘을 클릭하면 생명석을 얻을 수 있습니다.

30283.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 35 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
30283.d: 8미터 반경 내의 모든 적을 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

48018.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 사정거리 없음 · 0.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
48018.d: 15분 동안 악마의 마법진을 소환합니다. 악마의 마법진: 순간이동을 시전하면 해당 지역으로 순간이동하고 모든 이동 속도 감소 효과를 제거합니다.

48020.m: 3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
48020.d: 악마의 마법진으로 순간이동하며 모든 이동 속도 감소 효과를 제거합니다.

48181.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
48181.d:
유령의 영혼이 대상에 다가가 (주문력의 720.612%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 18초 동안 대상에 대한 공격력을 16%만큼 증가시킵니다.

대상이 죽으면 유령 출몰의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

89808.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
89808.d:
해로운 주문을 불태워 아군 대상으로부터 1개의 해로운 마법 효과를 제거합니다.

자동 시전:
주인이 마법 효과 때문에 주문을 시전할 수 없을 때 주인에게 사용합니다.

(마우스 오른쪽 클릭으로 사용 / 미사용)

104773.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
104773.d: 피부를 단단하게 만들어 8초 동안 받는 모든 피해를 25%만큼 감소시키고, 주문 방해 및 침묵 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

108416.d: 현재 생명력의 20%만큼을 희생시켜, 20초 동안 희생한 생명력의 200%만큼 피해를 흡수하고 추가로 (주문력 * 2.5)의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 자신에게 씌웁니다. 제어 방해 효과에 걸린 상태에서도 사용할 수 있습니다.

108558.d:
부패로 피해를 입히면 다음 어둠의 화살 또는 재앙의 손아귀의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다.

효과에 영향을 받는 동안 어둠의 화살이 즉시 시전되고 재앙의 손아귀가 50%만큼 더 빨리 시전됩니다.

111400.d: 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가하지만, 1초마다 최대 생명력의 4%에 해당하는 피해를 입습니다. 이동 방해 효과에 걸려도 이동 속도가 평상시의 100% 이하로 내려가지 않습니다. 활성화되어 있는 동안 지속됩니다.

111771.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 10 - 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
111771.d: 두 지점을 연결하는 악마의 관문을 생성합니다. 관문이 작동하면 사용자는 즉시 반대쪽 관문으로 전송됩니다. 플레이어마다 90초당 한 번씩만 악마의 관문을 사용할 수 있습니다.

119898.d:
악마에게 명령을 내려 가장 강력한 능력을 사용하게 합니다. 이 주문은 현재 소환수에 따라 달라집니다.
지옥사냥개: 주문 잠금
공허방랑자: 어둠의 보루
인큐버스/서큐버스: 유혹
임프: 마법 태우기

196103.d:
부패가 영원히 지속되고 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

플레이어를 대상으로 할 때는 지속시간이 24초로 감소합니다.

205180.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
205180.d:
뒤틀린 황천에서 암흑시선을 소환합니다. 암흑시선은 활성화된 동안 시전자의 고통, 부패, 불안정한 고통의 공격력을 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

암흑시선은 20초 동안 전투를 도우며 대상을 폭발시켜 (주문력의 487.044%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 이 피해는 암흑시선의 현재 대상에게 활성화되어 있는 지속 피해 효과 하나당 10%만큼 증가합니다.

234153.m: 0% (기본 마나 중) 및 매 초마다 추가 3% · 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (5 초 주문 시전 시간)
234153.d: 대상의 생명력을 흡수하여 5초에 걸쳐 총 25의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 자신은 적에게 입힌 피해의 500%에 해당하는 생명력을 회복합니다.

333889.d: 다음 임프, 공허방랑자, 인큐버스, 서큐버스, 지옥사냥개 또는 지옥수호병 소환이 자원을 소모하지 않으며 주문의 시전 시간이 90%초만큼 감소합니다.

334275.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
334275.d:
12초 동안 대상의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

저주: 흑마법사는 한 대상에게 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

385899.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 1개 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
385899.d:
영혼의 조각을 소모하여 주문의 잠재된 힘을 끌어냅니다.

악마의 마법진: 순간이동: 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가하고 6초 동안 감속 및 이동 불가 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

악마의 관문: 즉시 시전됩니다.

생명력 흡수: 30초 동안 치유량과 같은 양의 피해 흡수 보호막을 얻습니다. 이 보호막은 최대 생명력의 30%를 초과할 수 없습니다.

생명석: 생명석의 치유량이 30%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 사용 시 12초 동안 최대 생명력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

440043.d:
대상에게 쇠퇴가 부여되어 있을 경우, 불안정한 고통 시전 시 쇠퇴의 중첩이 1만큼 증가합니다.

쇠퇴의 중첩이 쌓일 때마다 일정 확률로 붕괴 작용을 일으켜 1초마다 중첩을 하나씩 소모해 (주문력의 144.468%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다. 대상에게 중첩이 하나만 남을 때까지 지속됩니다.

440057.d:
무력화 저주가 강화되어 사티로스의 저주로 변화합니다.

사티로스의 저주
2분 동안 대상의 공격 간격을 20%만큼, 모든 주문의 시전 시간을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

저주 주문: 한 대상에게 하나의 저주만 걸 수 있습니다.

440065.d: 어둠의 서약이 활성화된 동안 1초마다 (주문력의 205.73%)의 생명력을 회복합니다.

442726.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
442726.d:
20초 동안 암흑 마법을 방출해 영혼을 타락시킵니다. 이때 자신의 쇠퇴에 걸린 적은 (주문력의 1265.51%)의 암흑불길 피해를 받고 중첩이 6만큼 증가합니다.

타락한 동안 가속이 8%만큼 증가하고 공격 주문으로 영혼의 조각을 소모하면 쇠퇴 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

445468.m: 특성 · 1.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
445468.d:
대상에게 흉악한 저주를 내려 힘줄과 근육을 살라 먹게 합니다. 즉시 (주문력의 24.7969%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입히고 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 370.679%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다.

부패를 대체합니다.

449614.d:
악마가 시전자의 영혼에 자리를 잡습니다. 영혼의 조각이 생성됐을 때 탐스러운 영혼인지를 감별할 수 있도록 합니다.

탐스러운 영혼을 흡수하면 악마의 영혼을 방출해 대상의 10미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게 (주문력의 353.236%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

449638.d: 암흑의 수확 주문이 내면에 있는 악마에 의해 강화되어 정신을 집중하는 동안 1초마다 각각 탐스러운 영혼이 들어 있는 영혼의 조각 1개를 부여하도록 합니다.

449703.d: 어둠의 서약이 희생한 생명력의 50%만큼 추가로 피해 흡수 보호막을 부여합니다.

1257052.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 집중 (3 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
1257052.d:
자신의 피해를 입히는 주기적인 효과에 걸린 각 대상에게서 생명력을 흡수하여 3초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 839.552%) * (4)]의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다.

암흑의 수확으로 입힌 피해의 50%만큼 자신을 치유합니다.

1259790.m: 특성 · 영혼의 조각 1개 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
1259790.d:
대상을 고통에 빠뜨려 8초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 347.714%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 이 능력은 여러 번 중첩해서 사용할 수 있습니다.

효과가 해제되면 [(주문력의 86.9285%) * 6204 / 100]의 피해를 해제한 대상에게 입히고, 4초 동안 침묵시킵니다. 이 피해는 대상에게 부여된 중첩 하나당 15%만큼 증가합니다.

고통에 빠져 있는 동안 대상이 죽으면 영혼의 조각 1개를 생성합니다.

1259825.d: 고통의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가하며, 대상으로부터 15미터 내의 적에게 추가로 적중합니다.

1260264.d: 어둠의 화살로 피해를 입히면 20%의 확률로 다음 불안정한 고통 또는 부패의 씨앗이 영혼의 조각을 소모하지 않으며 즉시 시전됩니다.

1261149.d:
암흑시선이 활성화된 동안 어둠의 화살이 재앙의 손아귀로 변화합니다.

재앙의 손아귀
대상을 황혼으로 속박하여 4초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 1053%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

재앙의 손아귀로 피해를 입히면 시전자의 다른 모든 주기적인 고통 공격 효과가 즉시 통상적인 주기적인 피해의 30%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

1265813.d: 피로의 저주, 언어의 저주 또는 무력화 저주 시전 시 대상 10미터 내의 모든 적에게 저주를 겁니다.

1268884.d:
소모한 탐스러운 영혼 하나당 내면에 있는 악마의 영혼을 해방할 확률이 증가하며, 해방 시 9초 동안 적을 공격하게 합니다.

영혼 휘둘러치기
사악한 발톱으로 주위 적을 공격해 대상에게 (주문력의 195.514%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 10미터 내 다른 적에게는 (주문력의 130.346%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

1270255.d:
어둠의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소하고 반경은 2미터만큼 증가합니다.

공포의 울부짖음의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소하고, 추가 적 5명을 공포에 질리게 합니다.

1271699.d: 생명석 사용 시 5%의 생명력을 추가로 회복합니다.

1271802.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1271802.d:
엉겨 붙는 어둠의 안개구름을 불러내 대상과 10미터 내 모든 적을 감쌉니다. 감싸인 대상은 12초 동안 모든 주문의 시전 속도가 100%만큼 감소합니다.

저주: 흑마법사는 대상 하나당 단 하나의 저주 또는 역병을 걸 수 있습니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two kick slots that make Radiant Spellsower walk to the tank with Spell Lock (24 sec, Felhunter) on Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy). Spell Lock locks that school for 7 sec.

[제어] When a Spellsower gets low, put Curse of Exhaustion (50% movement slow, 12 sec) on it to slow its Call The Grove run, and let Foul Mouth spread it to enemies within 10 yards. If it reaches a Lasher pack and starts Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel), stop it with Shadowfury (1.5 sec cast, 3 sec stun).

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, press Summon Darkglare (2 min) with Dark Harvest (1 min), and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build. Press Dark Pact (1 min) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [우선 처치] Topicx says to kill the Sporeblight Belcher first in this pull because it does the AoE. Put Haunt (15 sec, 16% more damage from you) on the Belcher and apply Agony and Unstable Affliction to it first.

[차단] Decide before the pull which of the two Radiant Spellsowers your Spell Lock covers. A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so do not rely on Shadowfury for it.
[광역 피해] If Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 1 is not back, use Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec) for Spouting Floret, and eat a Healthstone if neither is available.
3: [광역 피해] When the 12 Lashers are stacked, spread Corruption with Seed of Corruption and hit every dotted mob with Dark Harvest (1 min), which is back after pull 1.

[제어] Put Curse of Exhaustion on whichever of the two Radiant Spellsowers gets low to hold it with the slow. On the Soul Harvester build Oppressive Darkness makes Shadowfury a 45 sec cooldown with a 10 yard radius, so stop both Spellsowers at once if they channel Frantic Blooming together.
5: [차단] Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech is a 4 sec cast that one ranged player can kick alone (Topicx). Cover it with Spell Lock (24 sec).
[제어] If Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal plus knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) comes at a bad time, stun it with Shadowfury to stop it (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Use Dark Pact on the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and start AoE with Seed of Corruption once the Virid Grovekeeper arriving 5-6 sec later is stacked too.
7: [차단] Cover Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Spell Lock, and send spare kicks to Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature).
[광역 피해] The two Luminous Thornmaws have a lot of health and live long, so time Summon Darkglare for this pull and put Agony and Unstable Affliction on both Thornmaws first.
[제어] Stun both Thorny Saptors with Shadowfury to stop their Thornclaw Leap.
8: [차단] Spell Lock one of the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Spouting Floret. If Dark Pact is not back after pull 7, use Unending Resolve. Stop Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap with Shadowfury.
10: [광역 피해] Affliction cannot remove Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew poison (the Imp's Singe Magic only removes Magic). Press Dark Pact during the 9 sec poison DoT and eat a Healthstone if your health drops low.

[우선 처치] When the two Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, Haunt that Lasher and focus single-target damage to break the shield first. Haunt's cooldown resets when the target dies, so use it again on the next Lasher right away.
11: [차단] Cover one of the three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech with Spell Lock, and if all three are stacked, use Blight of Tongues (2 min) to increase cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 100% for 12 sec and buy time to kick the rest.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Spouting Floret, and put Agony and Unstable Affliction on the Luminous Thornmaw first so Dark Harvest chips it down with the pack.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest on this pull. Haunt a Lasher that still has its shield, and when it dies use the reset Haunt on the next Lasher.
[차단] Decide which of the two Radiant Spellsowers your Spell Lock covers, and put Curse of Exhaustion on a low Spellsower to hold it with the slow. Press Dark Pact for Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction) with Spell Lock (24 sec, Felhunter). Missing even one puts the tank in danger (Topicx).

[해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots is a Magic effect that the Imp's Singe Magic (15 sec) can remove, and Wowhead says the Imp swap is worth it for Harrower packs. The Imp has no Spell Lock, so summon it instantly with Fel Domination (3 min) only when other players can cover both Serpent kicks.

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, stop the pack with Shadowfury (3 sec stun) to drop the 2 sec stacks (Topicx). Put Seed of Corruption into the stacked pack to spread Corruption.
2: [우선 처치] Put Haunt (15 sec, 16% more damage from you) on the Ritual Chieftain and apply Agony and Unstable Affliction to it first to kill the Chieftain first (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb) hurts the most in this area, so press Dark Pact (1 min) ahead of it. Afterwards use Dark Harvest (1 min). It heals you for 50% of its damage, so you can clear the heal absorb yourself.
[차단] Kick the Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down after you break line of sight behind the pillar, take one with Spell Lock, and if all three are stacked, use Blight of Tongues (2 min) to increase cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 100% for 12 sec and buy time to kick the remaining Piercing Hiss (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 2 is not back before Blood Sacrifice, press Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec), then eat a Healthstone.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Press Summon Darkglare (2 min) with Dark Harvest, and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build. Haunt the Ritual Chieftain and melt it first.

[광역 피해] The two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots Nature DoTs (48491 every sec for 20 sec) overlap with Blood Sacrifice, so press Dark Pact right before Blood Sacrifice (Topicx). If you brought the Imp, use Singe Magic to free one DoTed party member.
[회피] Dodge the Toxic Breath frontal (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) by swinging to the Harrower's side quickly with Burning Rush (50% movement speed), and cancel it right after.
7: [차단] If High Evolutionist's Envenom lands right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle, the DoT and the AoE overlap (Topicx), so save Spell Lock for that cast. Stun Evolve (6 sec channel) with Shadowfury to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec). Using Shadowfury on Evolve also stops the three Bloodletters' melee swings, so fewer blood pools land.
8: [제어] Stun all four Bloodletters for 3 sec with Shadowfury to delay the blood pools. On the Soul Harvester build Oppressive Darkness makes Shadowfury a 45 sec cooldown, so the one used on pull 7 is usually back.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 7 is not back before Rattle, press Unending Resolve.
9: [차단] The High Evolutionist standing far to the left is easy to forget, so take it as the ranged kicker with Spell Lock. Stopping its cast makes it walk to the pack (Topicx·Wowhead).

[우선 처치] When the two High Evolutionists are stacked, slow the second Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Blight of Tongues, and focus Haunt and Unstable Affliction on the Evolutionists to kill them before the second cast (Topicx).
11: [차단] Decide before the pull which of the four High Evolutionists next to the totem your Spell Lock covers. If all four are stacked, double their Mass Envenom cast time for 12 sec with Blight of Tongues (Wowhead).
[제어] When several channel Evolve together, stun them at once with Shadowfury. If only one is left, break it with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[광역 피해] Put Seed of Corruption into the four stacked Evolutionists and chip them down together with Dark Harvest.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Summon Darkglare and Haunt on this mini-boss (Topicx).
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), press Dark Pact and stack on the spot the tank marked (Topicx).
13: [우선 처치] Do not put Seed of Corruption into the six Living Venoms. It applies Corruption to every enemy within 10 yards when it explodes and Absolute Corruption keeps that DoT running, so the Venoms die together and their Venom Bursts stack (Topicx). Focus Haunt, Agony and Unstable Affliction on Ula'tek's Chosen.
[차단] The Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Spell Lock for the Chosen.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and during it stun the two Blades of the Altar with Shadowfury to stop their Laced Edge teleports.
14: [우선 처치] As on pull 13, keep Seed of Corruption off the Living Venoms and kill only Ula'tek's Chosen with Haunt. Kick Mass Envenom with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 13 is not back before Toxic Surge, press Unending Resolve. If Shadowfury is not back, incapacitate one Blade of the Altar for 3 sec with Mortal Coil.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Spell Lock. If other players can cover both kicks, swap to the Imp as on pull 1 and free Paralyzing Shots targets with Singe Magic (Wowhead).
[제어] When the four Blades of the Altar are stacked, stun them together with Shadowfury to delay their Laced Edge teleports.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge (Topicx). Haunt the Chosen and kick Mass Envenom with Spell Lock.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so take the first with Dark Pact and the second with Unending Resolve, and eat a Healthstone if a heal absorb remains. This pull has the heaviest healing load (Topicx).

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull that takes Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together (Topicx). Line up Summon Darkglare (2 min) and Dark Harvest (1 min) with Bloodlust, and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build.

[우선 처치] Bribed Captain's Deep Corruption reduces AoE damage taken by nearby mobs by 25%, so Haunt the Captain and stack Unstable Affliction to kill it first. Put Seed of Corruption in after the Captain dies.
2: [차단] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) takes one kicker per mob (Topicx), so Spell Lock (24 sec) one of them. If both Sayaads are close together, Shadowfury (3 sec stun) can stop them both.
5: [우선 처치] Haunt the Massive Felwyrm and kill it first (Topicx). Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd) goes off when it dies, so stay at range.

[해제] When a party member hit by Corroding Spittle (Magic) asks for a dispel, the Imp's Singe Magic (15 sec) can remove it (Wowhead). The Imp has no Spell Lock, so leave this pull's Felonious Mage kicks to other players.
8: [차단] Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) gives 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min if it goes through, so spend Spell Lock on the Flayer first. Stun both Fel Invokers' Health Funnel channels together with Shadowfury.
[우선 처치] Shivan Punisher deals Fire damage to the group until it dies once Demonic Frenzy starts below 50% (Topicx), so Haunt it right before 50% and line up Summon Darkglare on the Punisher.
[광역 피해] If Demonic Frenzy (29095 Fire every sec) drags on, press Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec).
9: [광역 피해] Press Unending Resolve when targeted by Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life. Without a defensive the Warlock heals a lot (Topicx). Curse of Doom is a Curse that Affliction cannot remove, so stack within 4 yards of the target to split the damage.
[차단] Take one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Spell Lock, and kill the eight Demon Flies at once with Seed of Corruption (Topicx: they are fine to pull in large numbers).
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Spell Lock (Topicx). If the second Invoker starts channeling, break it with Mortal Coil (45 sec, 3 sec incapacitate).
[우선 처치] Once Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, stack Haunt and Unstable Affliction to focus it down. Put Seed of Corruption on the Demon Flies so Corruption keeps chipping them.
11: [우선 처치] Stack Summon Darkglare and Haunt on Felmaster Lucsei so Blade Dance does not come out more than three times (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Use Unending Resolve, back after pull 9, for Blade Dance (2 sec cast, 43642 Fire every 0.4 sec), or eat a Healthstone if it is down. Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of its damage.
13: [제어] Apply Curse of Tongues on the Soul Harvester build or Curse of the Satyr on the Hellcaller build to the six Unleashed Imps so Foul Mouth increases cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 30% (Wowhead), and kill the pack with Seed of Corruption.
[차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Press Unending Resolve for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the whole group) if it is back, or eat a Healthstone if not.
14: [제어] When the six Unleashed Imps and the Fel Invoker are stacked, stun them together with Shadowfury to stop Felfire Burst and Health Funnel, and spread Curse of Tongues (Soul Harvester) or Curse of the Satyr (Hellcaller) with Foul Mouth as on pull 13.
[차단] Take one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Spell Lock.
15: [우선 처치] Pull the Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first, then take the Shivan Punisher separately (Topicx). Haunt the Warlock, and press Unending Resolve if Drain Life targets you. If Unending Resolve is down, heal 20% of max health with Mortal Coil.
[광역 피해] Once the Punisher drops below 50%, line up Summon Darkglare to end Demonic Frenzy quickly.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's AoE must end within two casts (Topicx), so stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest on the Golem and Haunt it. Use Unending Resolve or a Healthstone for Defiled Slam.
[차단] Kick one of the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel with Spell Lock and stun the other with Shadowfury to break it.

1: [광역 피해] The first Bloodlust and cooldowns go on this pull (Topicx), so press Summon Darkglare (2 min) with Dark Harvest (1 min), and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build.

[우선 처치] Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy totem must die before Insatiable Hunger lands a second time (Topicx). Hit it with Haunt right away instead of waiting on DoTs. Haunt's cooldown resets when the target dies. Insatiable Hunger is a Curse, so Affliction cannot remove it.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact when Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) is channeled.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Spell Lock (24 sec). If the cast goes through, remove the Healing Breeze effect from the Tender with the Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec) (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem with Haunt first, and press Dark Pact, back after pull 1, for Feast of Misery.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). The Summon Darkglare used on pull 1 is back, so use it with Dark Harvest.

[차단] Take one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Spell Lock, and if both are stacked, apply Curse of Tongues on the Soul Harvester build or Curse of the Satyr on the Hellcaller build so Foul Mouth increases cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 30% (Wowhead).
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up it pulses 24246 Nature to the whole group every 2 sec, so Haunt it and stack Unstable Affliction to break the shield.
[광역 피해] If the shield stays up and the Nature damage builds, press Dark Pact.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with Bloodlust and Haunt the Terra Rumbler.
[차단] Take one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% Haste and movement speed reduction on hit) with Spell Lock. The long cast is easy for a ranged player to kick (Topicx).
10: [차단] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). Kick one Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar with Spell Lock, and if both Maulers are stacked, double the remaining cast time for 12 sec with Blight of Tongues (2 min).
[광역 피해] Use Dark Harvest (1 min) as soon as it is back from pull 9. Spread Corruption across the stacked pack with Seed of Corruption.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first, then Terra Rumbler (Topicx). Focus Haunt and Unstable Affliction on the Avatar, and have Agony and Corruption already ticking on the Rumbler.
[광역 피해] If Glacial Tomb traps you (38793 Frost every 2 sec until broken), press Dark Pact and help break the ice on the stacked party members (Topicx).
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) with Spell Lock.
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) right away with Haunt.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact when the two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking) builds up (Topicx).
14: [우선 처치] When both Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems come out, break the first with Haunt and use the reset Haunt on the second right away (Topicx).

[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Spell Lock. If the third Bloodlust goes here, line up Summon Darkglare with it, and if it is saved for Loa Speaker Nanea in high keys, save Darkglare too (Topicx).
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns with Primal Echo (Topicx), so use Dark Pact on the first stacks, Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec) on the next, then a Healthstone.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Spell Lock, and if both are stacked, double their cast time for 12 sec with Blight of Tongues. Break Magma Totems with Haunt.
[광역 피해] The four Warbringers have a lot of health, so line up Summon Darkglare on this pull, put Corruption on the whole pack with Seed of Corruption and chip it down with Dark Harvest.
16: [차단] Put Spell Lock into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] Break the three Volatile Totems one by one with Haunt and carry the reset Haunt to the next totem each time one dies. Totems come first unless Nanea is around 10% health (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes here in high keys, line up Summon Darkglare with it.

1: [광역 피해] This is the Bloodlust pull that takes the first corridor up to Voidtouched Magi in one go (Topicx). Line up Summon Darkglare (2 min) and Dark Harvest (1 min) with Bloodlust, and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build.

[차단] Kicks are assigned in advance (Topicx). Take one of the two Enthralled Shamans' Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Spell Lock (24 sec), or take the second Shadowbolt Volley with Spell Lock after the tank kicks the first.
[광역 피해] If targeted by Null Eruption (4 sec cast, 145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus a 5 sec DoT), move out of the group and press Dark Pact (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] If even one of Raj'kess the Spellstorm's three Orb of Disruption casts finishes, party haste drops sharply (Topicx), so swap right away and hit the orbs with Haunt. Haunt's cooldown resets when an orb dies, so carry it to the next orb.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Thundering Storm's long party AoE, and if Dark Pact is down for the next Storm, press Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec) (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] This is the big 158-trash room. When the packs coming from the left and right walls are stacked, spread Corruption with Seed of Corruption and chip them down together with Dark Harvest.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec channel, 87284 Nature every 2 sec) (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, Haunt it and line up Summon Darkglare to stack damage (Topicx).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). Save Spell Lock for this cast.
[광역 피해] If targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), move out of the group and press Dark Pact (Topicx).
6: [우선 처치] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield must be broken quickly with damage cooldowns (Topicx). When the shield goes up, Haunt the Overseer and stack Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest on it.

[광역 피해] If the shield holds and the slams (48491 Physical to the group every 1.5 sec, +10% each) stack up, press Dark Pact, and add Unending Resolve if they overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
8: [광역 피해] This is a damage-cooldown pull (Topicx). Press Summon Darkglare with Dark Harvest, and stack Malevolence on the Hellcaller build.

[우선 처치] Kill the icon-marked mob that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast) right away with Haunt (Topicx). Haunt resets when the target dies, so carry it to the next Devour target. Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Dreadbellow (knockback plus 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, not dispellable).
9: [광역 피해] Put Corruption on all ten Scavenging Siphoids with a single Seed of Corruption to clean them up.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Spell Lock. Kill the Devour target first with Haunt (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 8 is not back before Dreadbellow, press Unending Resolve.
10: [우선 처치] Kill Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target first with Haunt, and put Agony and Unstable Affliction on the Watchful Harrower that is chained in when the Brutalizer is nearly dead (Topicx). This is a big 117-trash pull, so line up the returning Summon Darkglare on the Harrower.

[차단] Kick Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec channeled heal) with Spell Lock when you have room after the Devour target dies (Topicx), and if both Voidminders channel side by side, stun them together with Shadowfury.

1: [해제] The Minions of Zul on the way die when Bound by Shadow (a Magic shield) is removed, so strip them one at a time with the Felhunter's Devour Magic (15 sec, removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from an enemy) (Wowhead). If several come together, hold them with Shadowfury (3 sec stun) to buy time for the purges (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out on the first pull of the dungeon, so press Summon Darkglare (2 min) with Dark Harvest (1 min), and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build.

[광역 피해] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole group) needs a defensive on every cast, so take the first with Dark Pact (1 min) and the second with Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Spell Lock (24 sec, Felhunter). Put Curse of Tongues (30% longer casts) on the Hexer on the Soul Harvester build, or Curse of the Satyr on the Hellcaller build, to slow its next cast (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] For Shadow Whirlwind, press Dark Pact if the one used on pull 1 is back, otherwise eat a Healthstone. Summon Darkglare is not back yet, so chip the pack down with Dark Harvest alone.
4: [참고] When a pack wakes up, hold Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest until the tank has threat, and spread Agony only after the tank is on the pack (Topicx).

[차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec mind control) with Spell Lock first and leave Soul Bolt to the remaining kicks. If Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending lands, it is a Magic effect, so remove it with Devour Magic.

[해제] Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (30% less damage taken by nearby mobs) is Magic, so remove it with Devour Magic (Wowhead). When bleeds from the King A'akul and Bloodsworn Assassin pack stack up, press Dark Pact, then eat a Healthstone (Topicx).
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group plus a zone) hurts a lot, so press Dark Pact ahead of it and use Unending Resolve on the next Purifying Flame (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes here on a high key, line up Summon Darkglare with it.
[광역 피해] Put one Seed of Corruption into the nine Embalming Fluids pulled in near the end to clear them together (Topicx).
6: [차단] The two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT) needs two kickers, so take one Mummy with Spell Lock (Topicx). If both stand within 8 yards of each other, stun them together with Shadowfury to stop the casts.
[광역 피해] If the Entomb target is freed late, Wail of Mourning (77586 Shadow every 2 sec, growing) ramps up, so press Dark Pact and keep damaging next to the crypt.
7: [차단] As on pull 6, take one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge with Spell Lock and stop any leftover cast with Shadowfury (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Clear the eight Embalming Fluids together with one Seed of Corruption. Leave Putrid Seekers pools quickly with Burning Rush (50% movement speed) and cancel it right after.
9: [우선 처치] Put Haunt on one Spectral Shaman and apply Agony and Unstable Affliction to it first to kill it before more Healing Tide Totems come out (Topicx).

[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop, so if they are stacked use Blight of Tongues (2 min) to increase cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 100% for 12 sec, and kick Hex with Spell Lock. Stun the remaining casts together with Shadowfury (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleed (29095 Physical every sec for 12 sec) stacks on you, press Dark Pact.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-Bloodlust route this bridge pack is the third Bloodlust, so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with it (Topicx). Stack Malevolence on the Hellcaller build.
[차단] Kick the Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Spell Lock, and Haunt a Spectral Shaman to kill it first (Topicx).
[회피] If you are inside Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby plus a knock-up), leave quickly with Burning Rush.
12: [위치] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first, so do not open with Agony from 40 yards before the tank is on it (Topicx).

[위치] If the ranged DPS soaks the far Pool of Darkness, press Dark Pact before stepping in (Topicx). If you are the Dark Revelation target, get more than 20 yards from the group within 5 sec with Burning Rush.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, gives an ally an absorb shield and crowd-control immunity) with Spell Lock (24 sec, Felhunter).

[제어] When Deepstone Earthshapers' Tectonic Strike stacks get high on the tank, stop all four Earthshapers with Shadowfury (3 sec stun) so the stacks drop (Topicx). Primal Juggernaut is immune to crowd control, so do not count on stunning it.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull gathered up to the entrance, so on the Soul Harvester build spread Curse of Tongues across the pack with Foul Mouth (Wowhead), and use Seed of Corruption and Summon Darkglare (2 min). Press Dark Pact (1 min) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature to the group plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield must be kicked, so save Spell Lock for this channel.
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 1 is not back before Excavating Blast, press Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec).
3: [광역 피해] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage hits the group within 60 yards for 24246 Fire six times, once per strike, so get through each one with Dark Pact or a Healthstone. Draghar is immune to crowd control, so Haunt it to focus damage.
[제어] Stun the two Deepstone Earthshapers with Shadowfury to break their stacks, and kick the Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Spell Lock (Topicx).
5: [차단] Kicks go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, so assign Spell Lock to one Cinderweaver. Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so stun it with Shadowfury (Topicx).
[해제] The Blaze of Glory (15 sec channel) that Ashseer Flamelasher casts as it dies is Magic, so remove it with Devour Magic (15 sec, removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from an enemy) (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (106681 Fire to the group plus a DoT), and on the Soul Harvester build spread Curse of Tongues across the pack with Foul Mouth to slow Cinderbolt (Wowhead).
6: [광역 피해] Below 50% Flamegullet's Molten Blood keeps raising group damage, so line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest with the 50% mark to kill it fast. On 17+ keys Bloodlust goes here (Topicx).
[회피] If you are the Flame Breath target (4 sec cast frontal breath), step aside with Burning Rush, or dodge it with Demonic Circle: Teleport if you placed a Demonic Circle beforehand.
[해제] Remove Ashseer Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic, and stop Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury (Wowhead).
7: [제어] Stun both Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage together with Shadowfury, and kick Cinderbolt with Spell Lock. On the Soul Harvester build Oppressive Darkness makes Shadowfury a 45 sec cooldown, so the one used on pull 6 is usually back.
[해제] Remove a dying Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic. If both die together you can remove only one, so dodge the other whirlwind (Wowhead).
8: [위치] Thunderhead patrols near this pack, so do not put Seed of Corruption (damages every enemy within 10 yards when it explodes) out while it walks close (Topicx).
[제어] Stop Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury, kick Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Spell Lock, and remove Blaze of Glory with Devour Magic.
10: [광역 피해] Put Seed of Corruption into the six Storm Warriors, melt them with Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest, then chain into the next pack (Topicx). Stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build.
[광역 피해] If you are the target of Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), press Dark Pact, or Unending Resolve if it is down.
[제어] Stopping Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Shadowfury also stops Storm Warriors within 8 yards for 3 sec.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Spell Lock. If the Dark Pact (1 min) used on pull 10 is not back before Lightning Torrent, eat a Healthstone.
12: [광역 피해] High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health, 29095 Nature to the group every sec while up) stuns everyone within 60 yards for 4 sec if it expires, so break it fast with Haunt and Dark Harvest. If Bloodlust goes on Ryvati on a high key, line up Summon Darkglare with it (Topicx).

[해제] The Stormcloud Barrier on the Primal Thunderclouds Ryvati summons is Magic, so Devour Magic can remove it (Wowhead). Removing it sets off Stormcloud Detonation, so remove it when the group is ready.
[광역 피해] If you are the Lightning Torrent target, press Dark Pact or Unending Resolve.

1: [차단] Take one of the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Spell Lock (24 sec, Felhunter), and if all three are stacked, use Blight of Tongues (2 min) to increase cast time of enemies within 10 yards by 100% for 12 sec (Wowhead). Pull Adepts standing far back by breaking line of sight at the corner at the end of the tunnel (Topicx·Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Sandfury Stonefist is immune to crowd control, so Haunt it and kill it first, and press Dark Pact (1 min) for Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yards plus a knockback). A Lightning Bolt landing at the same time kills people, so save Spell Lock for the Ground Pound window (Topicx).
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Shadowfury (3 sec stun).
2: [위치] The two Shrouded Fangs below the stairs are stealthed, so do not put out Agony or Seed of Corruption before the tank engages (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If the Dark Pact used on pull 1 is not back before Ground Pound, press Unending Resolve (3 min, 25% damage reduction for 8 sec), and kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Spell Lock.
4: [우선 처치] Put Haunt on the Sand-Sworn Rider and apply Agony and Unstable Affliction to it first to kill it before Swarming Krolusks adds pile up (Topicx). The adds run at distant DPS, so stand close to the group.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Spell Lock, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Shadowfury.
5: [광역 피해] At 91 trash this is the biggest pull. Press Summon Darkglare (2 min) with Dark Harvest (1 min), and stack Malevolence (1 min) on the Hellcaller build. Haunt the Sand-Sworn Rider.

[차단] If the two Storm Adepts are stacked, use Blight of Tongues and take one with Spell Lock (Wowhead). A Lightning Bolt on someone already hit by Cytotoxin poison or a Krolusk bleed kills them (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If Cytotoxin (10 sec poison) or a Serrated Charge bleed is on you, press Dark Pact, or eat a Healthstone if it is down.
6: [차단] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind is a 5 sec cast that one kicker can handle, so take it with Spell Lock (Topicx). On the Soul Harvester build put Curse of Tongues (30% longer casts) on the Brood Tender to slow Venom Bolt (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Haunt the Sand-Sworn Rider and kill it fast (Topicx).
7: [차단] Take whichever of Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind or Brood Tender's Venom Bolt the group left open with Spell Lock. Do not let Venom Bolt land on top of Cytotoxin poison (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If Cytotoxin from the three Poisonous Vipers stacks on you, press Dark Pact. Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Shadowfury.
9: [해제] Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge (8% more damage, 3 stacks) is Magic, so remove it with Devour Magic (15 sec, removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from an enemy) (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole group) and Unending Resolve for the second one. Kick Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Spell Lock during it (Topicx).
[참고] Do not rush the Loose Sparks section: dodge the orbs first, then kill the Spark Channeler (Topicx).
10: [차단] The two Imbued Stormcallers must be shut down before the rest is gathered (Topicx), so take one with Spell Lock and use Blight of Tongues if both are stacked.

[광역 피해] Nimbus, Stormcallers and Static Anomalies together make this a dangerous pull, so have Dark Pact and a Healthstone ready for Release Charge (Topicx). Remove Accumulate Charge with Devour Magic (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Put Seed of Corruption into the four Static Anomalies and line up Summon Darkglare and Dark Harvest.
12: [제어] The Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb has to be crowd-controlled (Topicx), so hold it with Fear (20 sec disorient) to stop its Essence Disruption channel. Damage breaks it, so do not put Agony on that Disruptor. Kick the near Disruptor's channel with Spell Lock.
[광역 피해] Press Dark Pact for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yards plus a 10 sec DoT), and put Seed of Corruption into the gathered Faithless Conscripts (Topicx).
13: [제어] As on pull 12, hold the far Temple Disruptor with Fear and kick the near Disruptor with Spell Lock to protect the orb charge (Topicx). If the Dark Pact used on pull 12 is not back before Caustic Stomp, press Unending Resolve.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer is immune to crowd control and its Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked, so save Spell Lock for this cast.

[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, so spread Curse of Exhaustion (50% movement slow) within 10 yards with Foul Mouth and stop them with Shadowfury (Topicx). Put Seed of Corruption into the gathered Tormentors and Faithless Conscripts.
[위치] If you are the Latent Hex target, step out of the group and do not walk into the Hex Muck it leaves when it ends.
